title: Calendar and appointments | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Calendar and appointments
hero.lead: The calendar combines matches, training sessions, club meetings, general events, tasks and tournaments. Visibility and editing depend on each appointment’s permissions and your assignments.

body:
Read and filter the calendar

  • Today returns to the current date.
  • Previous and Next move by month, week or day according to the view.
  • Month, Week, Day and List change the display. Small screens provide Month, Day and List.
  • The coloured Match, Training, Club meeting, Event, Task and Tournament switches show or hide that type. A filled switch is active.
  • Select an appointment to open its details.

Create an appointment

New event appears if you may create appointments. On mobile, use the plus button.

  1. Select New event.
  2. Under Basic data, enter title, date and time. End date and time are optional.
  3. Choose the event type; Kaderblick adapts the following steps.
  4. For supported types, enable Response required if needed, then set a deadline and reminder times before it.
  5. Under Appointment reminders, add different reminder times. Without an entry, your profile setting applies.
  6. Use Next and Back. Cancel or X closes without saving.

The six event wizards

The event type defines the steps:

  • Match: Basic data → Match details → Additional players → Match timing → Description.
  • Training: Basic data → Training → Description.
  • Club meeting: Basic data → Permissions → Description.
  • Event: Basic data → Permissions → Description.
  • Task: Basic data → Task → Description.
  • Tournament: Basic data → Match details → Fixtures → Description.

Match

The title, end date and end time are optional. Attendance responses can include a deadline and reminders. Match details contain venue, home team, away team, match type, meeting point and meeting time. League, cup, competition or round fields appear when required by the match type.

Additional players: after selecting both teams, choose between players who declared availability and all age-eligible players, search, invite several players or remove a selection.

Match timing: set half length, break length and optional added time for each half. Kaderblick displays the total and can calculate the event end.

Create matches with teams outside the club

A club administrator may select or create teams that do not belong to their club. At least one of the two teams must be within the administrator’s club scope on the match date. Kaderblick derives this link from active team and club assignments. A match between two teams entirely outside that scope cannot be saved.

For a tournament, at least one planned fixture must contain a managed team. Super administrators are exempt.

Club meeting and event: venue and visibility

For general events, Permissions provides:

  • Public: no restriction to selected clubs, teams or people.
  • Clubs: choose the intended clubs.
  • Teams: choose one or more teams.
  • Users: choose individual people; displayed context distinguishes identical names.

For personal tasks, Kaderblick instead states that the item is visible only to you.

Create a training session

  1. Choose Training in Basic data. This type also offers responses.
  2. Select Next to open Training.
  3. Choose the location and required team.
  4. Choose 60, 75, 90, 105 or 120 minutes or enter a duration. Kaderblick calculates the end time.
  5. If required, enter meeting point and meeting time.

Create a training series

  1. Enable Recurring training.
  2. Choose at least one weekday.
  3. Enter the last date under Series until.
  4. Check the displayed number of appointments and complete the wizard.

When editing a series, Kaderblick asks which scope to change: this appointment only, appointments from this point, appointments on the same weekday or the series. You can also set a new end date for a shortened series.

Task

A personal task is visible only to you and can have its own reminder. For a shared task, select the user rotation and how many people are responsible at the same time.

Recurring tasks can repeat regularly or once per match. Regular recurrence supports daily, weekly and monthly intervals with weekday or day-of-month where applicable. Per-match recurrence uses an offset in days before or after each match.

Tournament

Choose venue, tournament type, match duration, break time and format, plus optional meeting details. Generate fixtures automatically, add them manually or import CSV/JSON; Clear list removes the current draft. Review and edit fixtures in the next step or add a new fixture.

Appointment details and attendance

Details show date, start and end and, where available, location, meeting point, meeting time, description and type-specific information. Weather and car-pool icons open their related information when available.

If responses are enabled:

  1. Open the appointment.
  2. With several relationships, first choose whom you answer for—yourself or an assigned player or coach.
  3. Choose one of the displayed attendance statuses. Names and colours come from the current Kaderblick configuration.
  4. If a note dialog appears, enter the note and confirm.

If the chosen player has a recorded absence, Kaderblick warns during the response. Authorised people additionally see participants grouped by status and can open the squad overview.

Edit, cancel, reactivate and delete

Actions appear only with the relevant permission:

  • Edit opens the wizard with existing data.
  • Cancel appointment marks it cancelled and may record a reason.
  • Reactivate reverses cancellation.
  • The bin starts deletion and requires confirmation. For recurring tasks, you may also choose which part to delete.
  • Share poster opens poster sharing when offered.

Differences by role and relationship

  • Coaches with appointment permission: see “New event” in the verified demo and can open the complete training wizard.
  • Participants: see released appointments and can respond when requested.
  • Parents and other linked accounts: can choose between available response targets.
  • Editors: receive only the actions Kaderblick permits for that appointment.

Connections to other areas

  • Matches and tournaments lead to their detail areas.
  • Calendar tasks also appear under Tasks.
  • Deadlines and appointments can trigger notifications.
  • Travel is organised under Car pools.
  • Set general appointment and response reminders under My profile.
